title: partnerships-marketplace-daily-notes-jordan-7
content:
Daily scratchpad - Partnerships / Marketplace (quick notes & next steps)
Date: 2026-03-04
Owner: Jordan Park

Morning recap:
- Call with Atlas.ai (partner) 9:30am — quick sync on SSO and onboarding timeline. They want a POC by end of month.
- Internal sync with Eng lead (Maya) 11:00am — clarified API contract and who owns staging infra.

Top priorities (today):
1) Atlas.ai POC checklist (high priority)
   - Share onboarding doc + sample API keys (action: Jordan) — due 2026-03-05
   - Confirm SSO flow (SAML) requirements — action: Samir to propose SAML mapping; due 2026-03-06
   - Provision sandbox Dedicated slot for 2-week POC — action: Maya to file infra request (JIRA-PART-314) — due 2026-03-06
   - Quick acceptance criteria doc for POC (minimal): 1) end-to-end generation with SSO auth; 2) latency < 300ms median; 3) cost estimate for pilot traffic — action: Jordan draft — due 2026-03-05

2) Marketplace listing readiness (medium)
   - Finalize marketing blurb & screenshots — action: Olivia to get copy from marketing — due 2026-03-10
   - Integration checklist: OAuth keys, rate limits, billing plan mapping, support contact — validate each item with partner.
   - Need to add "fallback model" guidance for partners to preserve SLOs — action: Eng (Maya) to recommend default variant — due 2026-03-09

Integration checklist (quick reminders)
- API onboarding: keys, scopes, sample requests — DONE (shared w/ partner 2026-03-02)
- Auth: SSO (SAML) vs OAuth2 — partner chooses SAML; confirm attributes (email, org_id, role) — PENDING
- Network: IP allowlist for sandbox + VPN details — PENDING (Maya to confirm IP ranges)
- Data handling: confirm logs retention and PII handling — Jordan to send standard NA privacy doc (link to CONFLUENCE-PLAT-872)
- Billing: map partner account to marketplace plan; need finance approval for introductory discount — ask finance (cc: Priya)
- Observability: add partner to per-route tracing; ensure token-level cost breakdown visible in console — Eng to enable monitoring hooks

Blockers / Risks:
- Dedicated sandbox capacity: current pool may be near capacity for 3/15–3/20 window; may need temporary burst capacity — Maya escalated to infra.
- Legal: partner agreement template needs security appendix for SSO and data retention; legal review could add 5–7 days.
- Atlas.ai internal product timeline is aggressive; need to lock POC acceptance criteria tomorrow.

Quick TODOs (tick when done):
- [ ] Draft POC acceptance doc (Jordan) — due 3/05
- [ ] Send SSO attribute list to Atlas (Samir) — due 3/06
- [ ] File infra request for sandbox Dedicated slot (Maya) — JIRA-PART-314 — due 3/06
- [ ] Request marketing blurb/screenshots from PMM (Olivia) — due 3/10
- [ ] Email finance re: pilot discount (Jordan) — include estimated tokens and duration

Notes / snippets from call with Atlas.ai:
- They want to use our streaming chat for multi-turn summarization.
- Primary use-case: high-throughput document ingestion -> summarization + embeddings for search.
- Concerned about cost for high token volumes; asked about batching and quantization recommendations.
- Suggested a co-marketing webinar if POC shows good latency/cost tradeoff.

Follow-ups for next sync:
- Run a quick perf test on current model variant with typical Atlas payload (10k tokens/session) — Eng to run and share numbers by 3/06.
- Prepare a simple demo flow for partner onboarding: sample app + curl examples + SSO steps.

Reference links:
- Confluence onboarding doc: CONFLUENCE-PLAT-872
- JIRA ticket: JIRA-PART-314 (sandbox infra)
- GitHub PR for marketplace integration: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-integration/pull/58

Random notes / ideas (brainstorm):
- Offer partner a pilot credits package (e.g., $1k credits + reduced rate for first month) — include terms.
- Consider an "accelerator" enablement checklist for marketplace partners: automated onboarding, test harness, sample data sets, and pre-approved SSO templates.

End of scratchpad.
summary: Daily personal scratchpad for partnerships: Atlas.ai POC next steps, integration checklist, blockers, and quick todos.
